title: NPvC: reproduce and improve original held-out neural prediction
goal: Recreate and improve the original Figure 2b,c held-out conditional prediction of deconvolved PPC activity using NPvC and GLM comparisons, retaining the complete source neuronwise FDE distribution and source-defined companion outputs across the original five epochs and eight trial types. Reproduction and improvement are separate outcomes under paired paper+data versus paper+data+official-code conditions. Separately retained biological reproduction: projection-specific pair interactions, network motifs and population-information findings in Figures 4–6 and their indispensable controls. These are preserved in the archived biological task and unchanged root reproduction contract; improved Figure 2 prediction does not establish them.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable original-source analysis plus complete source-native performance panel, observation-level predictions, identities, folds, preprocessing/normalization operands, eligibility/skip diagnostics and mandatory source controls defined in primary-endpoint-v1/reproduction.v2.json.

Improvement: candidate predictions and complete matched-source performance vector assessed against the strongest relevant source author comparison under an independently justified full-panel policy. No invented scalar, effect-size maximization or selected-subset completion.

Separate provenance: Separately retained biological reproduction: projection-specific pair interactions, network motifs and population-information findings in Figures 4–6 and their indispensable controls. These are preserved in the archived biological task and unchanged root reproduction contract; improved Figure 2 prediction does not establish them.
success_criteria: Recreate the explicitly selected original method endpoint under the same source dataset, population, split, inputs, preprocessing, metric and full support, with justified independent numerical/uncertainty assessment.

Surpass the strongest relevant source-author method on that same complete performance endpoint only after author/reference calibration and an independently justified frozen panel/effect/uncertainty policy. Reproduction fidelity and genuine performance improvement are separate outcomes.

Retain source controls, null/saturated/normalization operands, eligibility and skipped/undefined cases as fidelity requirements; do not turn diagnostic or biological effect quantities into maximize targets.
Keep paper_data and paper_data_author_code results separate with identical common data/artifact exposure and budgets; official implementation access is the declared information difference.

All current scientific outcomes remain unknown and readiness false. Contracts and source components alone do not establish authentic local acceptance, AI performance, paper-relative improvement or current SOTA.
Preserve the previous biological scope and its root contracts as historical/separately named evidence. This explicit method-primary selection does not claim completion of that broader biology.
participant_inputs: Original released analysis signals with complete provenance, source task/behavior/projection metadata and evaluator-authorized fold/exposure information. Shared algorithm-bearing fitted artifacts are not implicitly allowed; a specific identical assisted profile would require source and training-overlap provenance. Original conditional neural/behavioral inputs and source evaluation protocol, including trial correctness. Same data representation and manifests, development/final exposure and budgets in paper_data and paper_data_author_code; the latter alone adds pinned author implementation. Fitted final predictions, hidden reference scores and evaluator-held outputs are not development inputs. Any author-derived fitted artifacts require a separately frozen common assistance profile.
